text:
laura: idea: lightweight 'micro-lease-delta' on prefix demote. instead of moving ownership blobs we publish a 64-bit delta token (lease_delta) that lets readers detect that their cached view might be missing recent changes. small, shard-local, very cheap to bump.

ajay: interesting. how does this differ from existing lease epoch bumps or vslots?

laura: delta is intentionally monotonic per-prefix but scoped to short windows (seconds). key differences: 1) it's append-only (no full ownership transfer), 2) it's meant to be sampled by readers to choose stale vs strong read, 3) includes an optional compact 32-bit write-hint counter (whint) to reason about recency.

ben: race scenario: writer commits right after demote and increments whint. reader sees delta bump but gets older whint from cache. how do we avoid serving older data?

laura: wire includes X-Lease-Delta and X-Write-Hint. validation: if owner_response.whint < local_min_whint && lease_delta != local_delta => do strong fetch. otherwise serve with stale-warning metric.

kate: can we avoid thundering herd on strong fetch? maybe a leaky-token bucket per-shard that gates strong reads for bumped prefixes and returns stale on overflow for best-effort tenants.

ajay: yes, add per-shard emergency budget. also do randomized rehydrate backoff with exponential cap. that should tame storms.

ben: testing: 1) synthetic late-writer where writer wins after delta bump; 2) surge demote test across 500 prefixes; 3) strict dedup where tenant enforces monotonic reads. add load test capturing stale_serves ratio.

kate: metrics: lease_delta_bumps, stale_serves_pct_by_tenant, strong_fetch_retries, rehydrate_budget_exhausted. ops wants a debug flag to log headers for sampled requests.

ci-bot: canary/micro-lease-delta -> staging queued (job 11121) :rocket:

laura: next steps: I'll open a short RFC with header names, pseudo-code for validation, and the shard budget knobs. prefer feature-flag rollout off for Dedicated. reviewers: ajay + ben please.

ajay: I'll review and add sim harness for late-writer.

ben: ack. I'll wire the metrics and dashboard tiles.

kate: will prototype the leaky bucket and console alerting.

laura: thanks all. short PR coming in ~24h :heart:
